elapsed timestamp entry rejects malformed and unsafe boundaries
whole-second formatting supports minutes and unbounded hours
initial selections use whole seconds and fit both ends and short videos
native seeks clamp keyboard, scrub, refresh and SponsorBlock targets
the saved end loops to the fractional start or pauses with looping disabled
native source ending and direct tech seeks cannot escape the range
a shortened media source stops with an unavailable range error
a recovered source reactivates the saved boundaries after refresh
temporary preview ownership releases and restores native fractional bounds
an active owner cannot be overwritten and disposed bounds cannot reattach
preview source failures can report to their editor without poisoning the media
preview and stop preserve the original player state and release temporary bounds
closing a looped preview restores an originally paused source
editing a native clip suspends and restores its fractional immutable bounds
invalid or unavailable preview selections leave the source recoverable
source refresh failures stop a running preview without a persistent player error
profile disposal never restores the earlier personal playhead or resumes playback
cached-page suspension restores the source once and blocks work until pageshow
repeated previews and disposal release handlers and the singleton session
native clips never restore, save or clear full-video progress
startup does not overwrite restored progress; periodic save survives a fresh load
failed saves retry and normal requests never overlap
hidden page sends current position even with an outstanding request
successful in-flight save flushes the latest pending seek
periodic attempts stay fifteen seconds apart, including failed completion clears
account bars wait for server data and never fall back to stale local progress on error
local bars retain rounding and watched fallback; invalid durations hide partial bars
preview playback cannot start account tracking or save completion and beacon positions
pending account saves and local progress exclude temporary editing positions
